title: Guatemala
goal: Read how the internal armed conflict that followed the 1954 coup dragged on for thirty-six years, with violence in the Maya highlands that kept intensifying until the conflict ended in 1996.
grammar: De ahí en adelante: continuar una narración desde un punto

items: State how long Guatemala's internal armed conflict lasted.
Describe how violence in the Maya highlands intensified and how Rigoberta Menchú became a voice for Maya rights.
Explain why both sides accepted, after UN mediation, that military victory was impossible.
Explain how the toll of dead and disappeared kept growing until the conflict ended.
Use de ahí en adelante to continue a narrative from a point.
